name: Gijou Mitsumi
source:
A Living Dead Stalker belonging to the Gijo Living Dead Stalker Agency. Can be considered a rival of [url=/c34597]So'un[/url] and his comrades. Prideful to a fault, with a somewhat abrasive demeanor.

Practitioner of the Advanced Taisha School. Her ultrasonic vibro-katana, [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_shushimaru_anim.gif]Shoushimaru[/url], sunders all in its path.

[Spoiler]Lives with her undead brother [url=/c163329]Sumihiko[/url], having sworn herself to revenge against [url=/c34604]Milgram[/url].[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile]
